findings.title: Constructor validates grantType twice, never validates rawTokenId
findings.body: AccessTokenContext constructor calls Objects.requireNonNull(grantType, ...) twice and never checks rawTokenId, so a null rawTokenId is accepted and stored. Later encodeTokenId() concatenates ':' + rawTokenId, producing a malformed ID like "onrtac:null" or throwing NPE, breaking token creation and decoding.

findings.title: New abstract getShortcut() breaks existing custom grant factories
findings.body: OAuth2GrantTypeFactory adds String getShortcut() with no default implementation. Any existing third-party OAuth2GrantTypeFactory outside this repo will fail compilation and fail at runtime with AbstractMethodError when DefaultTokenContextEncoderProviderFactory casts to OAuth2GrantTypeFactory and calls getShortcut(). It must have a default value.

findings.title: Removed Context copy constructor and added NPE on null formParams
findings.body: The diff deletes the public Context(Context) copy constructor and adds grantType = formParams.getFirst(...) unconditionally in the remaining constructor. External grant implementations that copied contexts or passed null/lazy formParams will now fail to compile or throw NullPointerException. This is an incompatible SPI change.

findings.title: No null checks for clientSession/userSession when deriving session type
findings.body: getTokenContextFromClientSessionContext() dereferences clientSessionContext.getClientSession().getUserSession() and userSession.getPersistenceState() without checks. TokenManager.initToken() now calls this for every access token, including client-credentials, token-exchange, and other flows where clientSession or userSession can be null or persistenceState null, turning a simple generateId() into an NPE that fails token issuance.

findings.title: Decoder throws on malformed/foreign token IDs instead of returning UNKNOWN
findings.body: getTokenContextFromTokenId() throws IllegalArgumentException when the prefix before ':' is not length 6 or contains an unknown shortcut. If this decoder is later used on incoming tokens for the optimization described in the PR (introspection, userInfo, session lookup), any attacker-supplied, legacy, or foreign-issuer jti with a colon will cause an unhandled exception/500 instead of graceful fallback like the no-colon path that returns UNKNOWN.

findings.title: getShouldUseLightweightToken can NPE when session client is null
findings.body: The method dereferences session.getContext().getClient().getAttribute(...) without null checks. It is now called from DefaultTokenContextEncoderProvider.getTokenContextFromClientSessionContext() during TokenManager.initToken() for all tokens, where the session context client is not guaranteed to be set, so token creation can throw NPE where it previously just generated an ID.

findings.title: isAccessTokenId matcher inverted and checks wrong substring
findings.body: matchesSafely() returns false when items[0].substring(3,5).equals(expectedGrantShortcut), i.e. it rejects correct tokens and accepts wrong ones. Additionally substring(3,5) is wrong: the 6-char prefix is session(0-1)+tokenType(2-3)+grant(4-5), so the grant shortcut is substring(4,6). The helper will never validate the intended grant type.
